amb_park.prompt: City park ambience, leaves rustling in a light wind, small songbirds chirping, very faint traffic far away, no voices, no dogs

amb_river.prompt: Wide river bank ambience, gentle water lapping against a stone embankment, light breeze, distant gulls now and then, no voices, no boats

amb_square.prompt: Open town square ambience, soft indistinct crowd murmur, footsteps on cobblestones, pigeons cooing and wings fluttering, no music, no clear words

amb_yard.prompt: Quiet enclosed tenement courtyard ambience, muffled city hum beyond the walls, a few sparrows, faint clatter of dishes from an open window, no voices, no music

city_day.prompt: Daytime city street ambience, steady distant traffic hum, occasional far car passing, faint tram bell far away, no voices, no music, no horns

city_night.prompt: Quiet city at night ambience, low distant traffic rumble, soft electrical hum of street lamps, a single far car now and then, no voices, no music

clang.prompt: A car scraping into a steel road guard rail: one loud metallic clang with a short ringing metal tail and a brief scrape, no glass, no voices

crash.prompt: A small car crashing into another car at city speed: one heavy metal crunch, bending sheet metal, a little glass and plastic debris falling, short, no screams, no voices, no alarm

engine_high.prompt: Small 1.2 litre four-cylinder petrol hatchback engine held at a steady high 4500 rpm, straining, buzzy exhaust, heard from just behind the car, constant pitch, no gear changes, no revving up or down, no tyre noise, no voices

engine_idle.prompt: Small old 1.2 litre four-cylinder petrol hatchback engine idling steadily at about 850 rpm, heard from just behind the car, slightly rough idle, constant pitch, no revving, no voices, no music

engine_mid.prompt: Small 1.2 litre four-cylinder petrol hatchback engine held at a steady 2400 rpm under light load, heard from just behind the car, constant pitch, no gear changes, no revving up or down, no tyre noise, no voices

rain.from: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 (medium take 2, highs 3 dB down above 5 kHz)
rain.prompt: Moderate steady rain on a city street, even continuous patter on pavement, clearly audible but not a downpour, no thunder, no wind, no splashing cars

thump_hard.prompt: A small car bumping hard into a post: one firm dull metal and plastic thud, a short dent, no glass, no debris, no voices

thump_soft.prompt: A car's plastic bumper gently nudging a wall at walking speed: one soft short muffled bump, no metal, no glass, no voices

traffic_bus.prompt: City bus diesel engine driving steadily, deep low rumble and heavy tyre roll, heard from the pavement close by, constant, no brakes, no air hiss, no voices

traffic_car.prompt: Small petrol car cruising steadily at city speed, smooth engine hum and tyre roll on asphalt, heard from close beside it, constant, no passing, no horn, no music

traffic_tram.prompt: Modern city tram rolling steadily along street rails, soft electric motor whine, steel wheels on rails with rhythmic clicks over rail joints, constant, no bell, no voices

tyre_roll.prompt: Close microphone mounted at a car's front wheel while driving at a constant 50 km/h on smooth dry asphalt: steady even tyre roar and road rumble at one constant level the whole time, no pass-by, no fade in or out, no engine, no wind, no voices

tyre_squeal.prompt: One long unbroken tyre squeal at a constant level and constant pitch, rubber screeching on dry asphalt during a long steady drift, sustained the whole time with no gaps, no start or stop, no engine, no crash, no voices

tyre_wet.prompt: Car tyres rolling through a wet rainy road at steady speed, constant water spray hiss and swish, no engine, no rain drops on roof, no splashes from puddles, constant, no voices
